about.title: About me
about.description:
Fullstack software engineer for almost 15 years, I have worked with all kinds of structures. In 2013, I co-founded Lonestone, around a video game project. The company is now a product studio of about 30 people, where I continue to design, develop and grow various products.

Specialized in the TypeScript ecosystem, I intervene throughout the life cycle of projects: from defining needs to production, through architecture, development and team support.

I have also had the opportunity to live and study in France as well as abroad, particularly in South Korea where I followed part of my curriculum at Inha University. These experiences have allowed me to acquire a good command of English, but above all to develop a strong sensitivity to cultural contexts, international collaboration and openness to other ways of working.

work.title: My work
work.description: Some projects I had the opportunity to help build in the context of my work

live.title: LIVE
live.description:
On SNCF Connect & Tech's LIVE project, I contributed to the development of an on-premises remote deployment solution used to manage and update passenger information workstations.
The project brought together several dozen developers, designers, product owners, and scrum masters, organized into squads of 5 to 10 people working in an agile setup.
I mainly worked with Node.js, alongside C++, NSIS, and React, following a hexagonal architecture and a test-driven development (TDD) approach.

moment.title: Mom3nt.AI
moment.description: As part of a small development team, I contributed to the full development of mom3nt.ai, an AI-powered sales nurturing platform. The product analyzes CRM data, customer interactions, and market signals to help sales teams identify opportunities and deliver personalized follow-ups. I contributed to the entire product lifecycle, from initial development to production release, onboarding the first customers, and handing the project over to the internal engineering team. Built with TypeScript, NestJS, React, BullMQ, Vercel AI SDK, and Langfuse.

sportall.title: Sportall
sportall.description: At Sportall, I contributed to the development of a live and on-demand sports streaming platform. I worked on key features including resilient multi-terabyte file uploads with resumable transfers, video playback tracking with resume support, and scaling the platform to handle traffic spikes during major sporting events. Built with TypeScript, Express, GraphQL, React, AWS, and MongoDB.

imie.title: IMIE
imie.description: As a teacher at IMIE, a higher education institution specializing in digital technologies, I taught students and career changers across several core areas of software development. I delivered both theoretical and hands-on courses covering JavaScript, databases, Git, web application development, and cloud computing fundamentals. The training emphasized practical, project-based learning, with a strong focus on software engineering best practices, collaborative development workflows, and preparing students for real-world professional environments.

work.more: And many more: server management, SaaS for office rental, platform for creating and selling online courses, Twitch extensions, bots for Slack, Discord, Twitter,...

side-projects.title: My side projects
side-projects.description: Stuff I build on my free time

lonard.title: Lonard
lonard.description: Lonard is a private, open-source family-oriented social network. It gives a family its own small, closed space to stay in touch across generations: sharing news, keeping a shared calendar of events and birthdays, exploring the family genealogy, and maintaining member profiles and relations. Everything is invite-only and access-controlled: there is no public feed, no advertising, and no third-party tracking. It is meant to be self-hosted by a family for a family.

mermoz.title: Mermoz
mermoz.description: Proprietary SaaS platform for flight schools and private pilots, created in collaboration with a UX designer. Mermoz centralizes fleet management and flight scheduling through an intuitive interface with detailed operational tracking.

vue-grille-pain.title: Vue grille pain
vue-grille-pain.description: Lightweight toast library built to test and play around with the composition API of Vue 3.

life-game.title: Conway's game of life
life-game.description: Implementation of Conway's game of life in TypeScript, with a simple user interface and a fluid animation in react and canvas.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: I design and build scalable web platforms from backend architecture to deployment. My focus is TypeScript ecosystems, cloud infrastructure, API design, and product engineering.
